title: Completely Unacceptable
text:
8/10/26
I have had this app since around 2012 and have used it for YEARS to store and protect my personal photos. I was literally adding photos this morning when, all of a sudden, the app told me that my Premium subscription had expired.

Now I’m being given three different options to renew/upgrade — monthly, yearly, or through the App Store — but NONE OF THEM WORK. Every time I select an option, I get an error.

The biggest problem is that I CANNOT EVEN ACCESS THE PHOTOS I ALREADY HAVE STORED IN THIS APP. These are my personal photos that I have trusted this app with for over a decade.

I also do not understand why I am suddenly being asked to pay again in the first place. When I originally paid for this app years ago, my understanding was that I purchased the version that did not require an ongoing subscription. Now, years later, I’m apparently being told my “Premium” access is gone and I need to pay again — AND the app won’t even let me purchase whatever it is asking me to purchase.

What exactly changed? Why am I being locked out of photos that I have already stored in an app I’ve used since 2012?

At the very least, I should be able to access my existing photos, and if you’re going to require some new subscription model, the purchase/restore process needs to actually work.

This is incredibly frustrating and completely unacceptable. I trusted this app with years of personal photos, and now I can’t access them or even resolve the issue through the options the app provides. Fix this.

title: If I could give it -5 stars, I would.
text:
“This app screwed up 10 years of files!”

I am a digital designer. I have used this app as a way to organize my photos on my iPad for almost 10 years. 

As of last year, when I discovered that you could pay for premium and get the ability to make sub folders my life got significantly easier.

That is until yesterday, when every sub folder, miraculously moved all the way to the top, scrambling 10 years worth of files and 50 projects that were half done. I spent all of yesterday trying to put it back together and figure out what was going on only for it to happen again today. I am so unbelievably angry and I’m thinking about finding a way to take some form of legal action.

Because in addition to completely scrambling my work life, I’ve noticed that certain files and folders are just completely gone. Not in a deleted folder not secretly hidden somewhere else, just gone. 

My recommendation to anyone thinking about getting this app is: dont!

Or at the very least, do not pay them a single cent for premium .

I tried changing the Wi-Fi, logging in and out of the acccount on both phones and restarting the download, I even tried to contact the customer service but nobody is responding to my emails.

Don’t waste your time and money like I did
